.subckt Xfmr P1 P2 S1 S2 params: Lm=100u Ns=3.6 K=0.99 Rwp=0.5 Rws=0.1 Rcore=1e6 Cww=0

Rws  S1  S1a {Rws}
Lp   P1a P2  {Lm}
Ls   S1a S2  {Lm*Ns*Ns}
K1   Lp  Ls  {K}
Rcore P1a P2 {Rcore}
Cww  P1a S1a {Cww}
.ends Xfmr

VIN VIN_src 0 DC 400
RVIN_series VIN_src n0 0.2
VPWM1 n_PWM1_int n2 PULSE(0 15 0 1e-07 1e-07 4.7e-06 1e-05)
RPWM1_drive n_PWM1_int n1 50
VPWM2 n_PWM2_int 0 PULSE(0 15 5.2e-06 1e-07 1e-07 4.7e-06 1e-05)
RPWM2_drive n_PWM2_int n4 50
VPWM3 n_PWM3_int n7 PULSE(0 15 2e-06 1e-07 1e-07 4.7e-06 1e-05)
RPWM3_drive n_PWM3_int n6 50
VPWM4 n_PWM4_int 0 PULSE(0 15 7.2e-06 1e-07 1e-07 4.7e-06 1e-05)
RPWM4_drive n_PWM4_int n8 50
VSW1_SENSE n0 n_SW1_dsense 0
MSW1 n_SW1_dsense n1 n2 n2 nmos_model
VSW2_SENSE n2 n_SW2_dsense 0
MSW2 n_SW2_dsense n4 0 0 nmos_model
VSW3_SENSE n0 n_SW3_dsense 0
MSW3 n_SW3_dsense n6 n7 n7 nmos_model
VSW4_SENSE n7 n_SW4_dsense 0
MSW4 n_SW4_dsense n8 0 0 nmos_model
VL_R_SENSE n2 n_L_R_sense 0
RL_R_ESR n_L_R_sense n_L_R_ser 0.02
L_R n_L_R_ser n3 1e-05 IC=0
CL_R_par n2 n3 2e-11
RL_R_core n2 n3 1e+06
VT1_SENSE_PRI n3 n_T1_p1_sense 0
VT1_SENSE_SEC n9 n_T1_s1_sense 0
XT1 n_T1_p1_sense n7 n_T1_s1_sense n10 Xfmr Lm=0.002 Ns=0.1 K=0.99 Rwp=0.1 Rws=0.05 Rcore=1e+06 Cww=0
R_ISO n10 0 1e+08
R_ISO_S1 n9 0 1e+08
VD1_SENSE n9 n_D1_sense 0
RD1_SENSE_DAMP n_D1_sense n_D1_damp 0.001
D1 n_D1_damp n11 Dmodel
VD2_SENSE n10 n_D2_sense 0
RD2_SENSE_DAMP n_D2_sense n_D2_damp 0.001
D2 n_D2_damp n11 Dmodel
VD3_SENSE n13 n_D3_sense 0
RD3_SENSE_DAMP n_D3_sense n_D3_damp 0.001
D3 n_D3_damp n9 Dmodel
VD4_SENSE n13 n_D4_sense 0
RD4_SENSE_DAMP n_D4_sense n_D4_damp 0.001
D4 n_D4_damp n10 Dmodel
VL_OUT_SENSE n11 n_L_OUT_sense 0
RL_OUT_ESR n_L_OUT_sense n_L_OUT_ser 0.02
L_OUT n_L_OUT_ser n12 5e-05 IC=0
CL_OUT_par n11 n12 3e-11
RL_OUT_core n11 n12 1e+06
VCout_SENSE n12 n_Cout_sense 0
LCout_ESL n_Cout_sense n_Cout_esl 1e-10
RCout_ESR n_Cout_esl n_Cout_esr 0.01
Cout n_Cout_esr n13 0.00047 IC=0
RCout_LEAK n12 n13 1e+07
VR_LOAD_SENSE n12 n_R_LOAD_sense 0
LR_LOAD_PL n_R_LOAD_sense n_R_LOAD_mid 1e-08
R_LOAD n_R_LOAD_mid n13 2

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9

.endc
